context_requirements: Expression of at least one PPAR subtype (PPARA, PPARD, or PPARG)
Presence of RXR heterodimer partner and functional PPRE-driven transcription
For PPARG-mediated effects, sufficient PPARG expression or ligand-dependent activation
For PPARA-mediated effects, fatty acid metabolic context and PPARA expression
For PPARD-mediated effects, active beta-catenin or growth factor signaling may enhance response
falsifiers: No consistent change in canonical PPAR target genes (e.g., PDK4, ANGPTL4, FABP4, UCP2, ACOX1) at 6 or 24 h in any cell line
Lack of dose-dependent transcriptional response across the nine cell lines
Predominant upregulation of inflammatory genes (e.g., IL1B, CXCL2, PTGS2) rather than PPAR target genes
No difference in response between PPAR-expressing and PPAR-negative lines
